_comment: The named cast. All models are Quaternius CC0 packs fetched by fetch_assets.sh; blend paths are relative to this directory and absolutized by compose.py. Recolors use render_scene.py's in-place tree-rebuild (slot copies silently no-op on these library materials). Shirt color IS character identity across panels — keep them stable. Faces are basic by design: emotion comes from pose, camera, and bubble shape.

omar.bio: Lead trainer. Patient, asks before telling. The suit.

sara.bio: Sharp engineer, usually right, occasionally overconfident — the protagonist of most dilemmas. Teal shirt.

khalid.bio: Junior admin, enthusiastic, clicks before reading — the cautionary tale. Amber shirt.

noor.bio: Ops lead. Calm under incident, speaks last, usually the voice of the correct answer. Indigo dress.

hamdan.bio: Security engineer, skeptical of everything — the one who asks 'but who approved this?'. Slate shirt.
